mapper.select: SELECT u.id as userId, u.type as userType, u.login_id as userLoginId, u.password as userPassword, u.fullname as userFullname, u.gender as userGender, u.birthday as userBirthday, u.mobile as userMobile, u.email as userEmail, u.address as userAddress, u.profile_img as userProfileImg, u.session_id as userSessionId, u.auto_login_limit as userAutoLoginLimit, u.wrong_password_count as userWrongPasswordCount, u.created_at as userCreatedAt, u.updated_at as userUpdatedAt, u.deleted_at as userDeletedAt, c.id as courseId, c.name as courseName, le.id as leId, le.completion_status as leCompletionStatus FROM user u LEFT JOIN learner_enrollment le ON u.id = le.user_id LEFT JOIN course c ON le.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN staff_assignment sa ON c.id = sa.course_id LEFT JOIN staff_detail sd ON sa.user_id = sd.user_id WHERE le.id = #{leId} AND ( u.id = ${loginUserId} OR ( u.type = 'LEARNER' AND ( (sd.position = 'GENERAL_MANAGER') OR (sd.position IN ('COURSE_HEAD', 'FULLTIME_INSTRUCTOR') AND sa.user_ID = #{loginUserId}) ) ) )

SELECT t.id AS testId, ts.id AS tsId, ts.submission_status AS tsSubmissionStatus, ts.score AS tsScore, ts.is_invalidated AS tsIsInvalidated FROM test t LEFT JOIN test_submission ts ON t.id = ts.test_id WHERE
t.course_id = #{enrolledCourseId} AND ts.learner_id = #{learnerId}

SELECT h.id AS homeworkId, hs.id AS hsId, he.id AS heId, he.is_pass AS heIsPass FROM homework h LEFT JOIN homework_submission hs ON h.id = hs.homework_id LEFT JOIN homework_eval he ON hs.id = he.hs_id WHERE
h.course_id = #{enrolledCourseId} AND (hs.learner_id = #{learnerId} OR hs.learner_id is NULL)

SELECT p.id AS pId, pr.id AS prId, p.status AS pStatus, p.participation_date AS pParticipationDate, p.training_time AS pTrainingTime, pr.explanation AS prExplanation FROM participation p LEFT JOIN participation_reason pr ON p.id = pr.participation_id WHERE p.learner_enrollment_id = #{leId} AND p.participation_date < date_add(NOW(), INTERVAL -1 DAY) ORDER BY participation_date DESC

SELECT p.id AS pId, pr.id AS prId, p.status AS pStatus, p.participation_date AS pParticipationDate, p.training_time AS pTrainingTime, pr.explanation AS prExplanation FROM participation p LEFT JOIN participation_reason pr ON p.id = pr.participation_id WHERE p.learner_enrollment_id = #{leId} AND p.participation_date < date_add(NOW(), INTERVAL -1 DAY) ORDER BY participation_date DESC LIMIT #{pageParticipationReqDTO.offset}, #{pageParticipationReqDTO.pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM participation WHERE learner_enrollment_id = #{leId} AND participation_date < date_add(NOW(), INTERVAL -1 DAY)
mapper.update: UPDATE employment_support SET employment_status = #{employmentSupportReqDTO.employmentStatus}, company_name = #{employmentSupportReqDTO.companyName}, company_phone = #{employmentSupportReqDTO.companyPhone}, company_address = #{employmentSupportReqDTO.companyAddress}, is_counseling_received = #{employmentSupportReqDTO.isCounselingReceived}, counseling_details = #{employmentSupportReqDTO.counselingDetails} WHERE learner_enrollment_id = #{leId}
